personality_one_liner: A clinical yet calming, highly readable interface focusing on immediate metabolic data clarity and user trust.

spacing.rule: Use iOS-native spacing rhythms with generous padding around core health metrics. Thumb zone CTA where applicable.

do's: Use glass effect on sticky headers over scrolling graphs.
Use glass for the bottom tab bar.
Use glass for floating action buttons or bottom-sheet handles.
dont's: Do not apply glass to dense data rows or generic list items.
Do not blur form fields or input elements.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Provide an immediate, clear overview of the current glucose value, trend, and recent history graph.

states.empty: No sensor connected state with illustration and 'Start Demo or Manual' CTA
states.error: Error message with retry connection button

screens.layout: Top section: large current glucose value (using displayFontFamily) with trend arrow and delta. Below: live glucose graph with high/low target range bands. Floating Action Button (FAB) or bottom sheet trigger for adding treatments (insulin/carbs). AI summary card at the bottom of the scroll view. Status/alarm banners sticky at the top if active.

screens.name: History
screens.purpose: Allow users to browse past day logs, view daily graphs, and see list of logged events.

states.empty: No data for this day message

screens.layout: Sticky header with prev/next day navigator. Scrollable view containing the day's graph at the top, followed by a chronological list of events (glucose readings, carbs, insulin) as standard list rows.

screens.name: Stats
screens.purpose: Display aggregate health metrics over selectable time periods (1/7/14/30 days).

states.empty: Not enough data to generate stats

screens.layout: Segmented control at the top for time period selection. Large 'Time in Range' stacked horizontal bar chart. Below: Grid of cards for Average Glucose, GMI, and SD (Standard Deviation). Use display font for large stat numbers.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Configure app preferences, thresholds, units, and Nightscout integration.
screens.layout: Standard iOS grouped list layout. Sections for: Units (mg/dL / mmol/L), Glucose Thresholds (High/Low inputs), Data Source (Demo/Manual toggle), and Nightscout Sync (URL/Secret inputs + Upload CTA).

ai_summary_bg.alt: Subtle light gradient background for the AI summary card

empty_state_medical.alt: Minimalist medical sketch for empty states

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the iOS-Native Clean personality. Keep the interface extremely readable with generous padding (lg/xl).
The primary focus is the live glucose reading. Use the `SpaceGrotesk` font for the large number, trend arrow, and delta. Color code the number based on the range (inRange, high, low).
Implement the glucose graph with clear visual bands for target ranges. Overlay treatment markers (carbs/insulin) directly on the graph or below it.
Use standard iOS grouped lists (`surfaceSecondary` cards on a `surface` background) for Settings and Stats grid.
The AI summary card should use the `ai_summary_bg` image with a gradient-to-dark scrim (as per imagery rules) overlaid with white text, providing a premium feel.
Banners for High/Low alarms should be distinct (using `warning` or `error` surface colors) but not overly aggressive. Pin them below the header when active.
Use a Bottom Sheet for adding treatments (insulin/carbs/note) to keep the user in the context of the Home screen graph.
Ensure numeric inputs and displays adapt correctly to the chosen unit (mg/dL vs mmol/L) as per the settings state.
